    ENGLISH

    Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have exhibited remarkable performance on various vision-language tasks such as Visual Question Answering (VQA). Despite accumulating evidence of privacy concerns associated with task-relevant content, it remains unclear whether MLLMs inadvertently memorize private content that is entirely irrelevant to the training tasks. In this paper, we investigate how randomly generated task-irrelevant private content can become spuriously correlated with downstream objectives due to partial mini-batch training dynamics, thus causing inadvertent memorization. Concretely, we randomly generate task-irrelevant watermarks into VQA fine-tuning images at varying probabilities and propose a novel probing framework to determine whether MLLMs have inadvertently encoded such content. Our experiments reveal that MLLMs exhibit notably different training behaviors in partial mini-batch settings with task-irrelevant watermarks embedded. Furthermore, through layer-wise probing, we demonstrate that MLLMs trigger distinct representational patterns when encountering previously seen task-irrelevant knowledge, even if this knowledge does not influence their output during prompting. Our code is available at https://github.com/illusionhi/ProbingPrivacy.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how training objectives affect the consistency of representations across datasets and their relationship to task behavior, offering a transferable framework for analyzing representation geometry. It does not investigate compositionality, reasoning, or model systems.

    本文研究训练目标如何影响不同数据集间表征的一致性及其与任务行为的关系，并提供了一个可迁移的框架来分析表征几何。该研究未探讨组合性、推理或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The Platonic Representation Hypothesis claims that recent foundation models are converging to a shared representation space as a function of their downstream task performance, irrespective of the objectives and data modalities used to train these models (Huh et al., 2024). Representational similarity is generally measured for individual datasets and is not necessarily consistent across datasets. Thus, one may wonder whether this convergence of model representations is confounded by the datasets commonly used in machine learning. Here, we propose a systematic way to measure how representational similarity between models varies with the set of stimuli used to construct the representations. We find that the objective function is a crucial factor in determining the consistency of representational similarities across datasets. Specifically, self-supervised vision models learn representations whose relative pairwise similarities generalize better from one dataset to another compared to those of image classification or image-text models. Moreover, the correspondence between representational similarities and the models' task behavior is dataset-dependent, being most strongly pronounced for single-domain datasets. Our work provides a framework for analyzing similarities of model representations across datasets and linking those similarities to differences in task behavior.

    柏拉图表征假说认为，近期的基础模型正随着下游任务表现而趋向于共享的表征空间，无论训练这些模型时使用了何种目标和数据模态（Huh et al., 2024）。表征相似性通常针对单个数据集进行测量，且在不同数据集间未必一致。因此，人们可能会想知道，模型表征的这种趋同是否受到机器学习中常用数据集的混杂影响。本文提出一种系统方法，用于测量模型间的表征相似性如何随构建表征所用的刺激集合而变化。我们发现，目标函数是决定表征相似性在不同数据集间一致性的关键因素。具体而言，与图像分类模型或图像文本模型相比，自监督视觉模型学到的表征，其相对成对相似性从一个数据集迁移到另一个数据集时具有更好的泛化性。此外，表征相似性与模型任务行为之间的对应关系取决于数据集，在单领域数据集上最为明显。我们的工作提供了一个框架，用于分析不同数据集间模型表征的相似性，并将这些相似性与任务行为差异联系起来。

    A Theoretical Study of (Hyper) Self-Attention through the Lens of Interactions: Representation, Training, Generalization

    从交互视角对（超）自注意力进行理论研究：表征、训练与泛化

    Muhammed Ustaomeroglu, Guannan Qu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how self-attention learns and generalizes pairwise interactions, then proposes modules for composing feature-level and multi-entity interactions. This provides substantial insight into compositional architecture and generalization, but does not investigate internal representations mechanistically, reasoning capabilities, or system organization.

    本文分析了自注意力如何学习和泛化成对交互，并提出了用于组合特征层级交互及多实体交互的模块。这为组合式架构和泛化提供了重要见解，但未从机制层面研究内部表征、推理能力或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-attention has emerged as a core component of modern neural architectures, yet its theoretical underpinnings remain elusive. In this paper, we study self-attention through the lens of *interacting entities*, ranging from agents in multi-agent reinforcement learning to alleles in genetic sequences, and show that a single layer linear self-attention can *efficiently* represent, learn, and generalize functions capturing pairwise interactions, including out-of-distribution scenarios. Our analysis reveals that self-attention acts as a *mutual interaction learner* under minimal assumptions on the diversity of interaction patterns observed during training, thereby encompassing a wide variety of real-world domains. In addition, we validate our theoretical insights through experiments demonstrating that self-attention learns interaction functions and generalizes across both population distributions and out-of-distribution scenarios. Building on our theories, we introduce *HyperFeatureAttention*, a novel neural network module designed to learn couplings of different feature-level interactions between entities. Furthermore, we propose *HyperAttention*, a new module that extends beyond pairwise interactions to capture multi-entity dependencies, such as three-way, four-way, or general $n$-way interactions.

    自注意力已成为现代神经网络架构的核心组件，但其理论基础仍不明晰。本文从*交互实体*的视角研究自注意力，这些实体涵盖多智能体强化学习中的智能体以及遗传序列中的等位基因等；我们证明，单层线性自注意力能够*高效地*表示、学习并泛化捕捉成对交互的函数，包括分布外场景。我们的分析表明，在对训练期间观察到的交互模式多样性只作最低限度假设的情况下，自注意力充当*互交互学习器*，因而涵盖了广泛的现实领域。此外，我们通过实验验证了理论见解，实验表明自注意力能够学习交互函数，并在不同总体分布及分布外场景中实现泛化。基于这些理论，我们提出了*HyperFeatureAttention*，这是一种新型神经网络模块，旨在学习实体之间不同特征层级交互的耦合。此外，我们提出了*HyperAttention*，这是一种新模块，能够超越成对交互，捕捉多实体依赖关系，例如三方、四方或一般的 $n$方交互。

    Yin Lu, Xuening Zhu, Tong He, David Wipf

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes a hybrid autoencoder, proves recovery of structured data across unions of manifolds, and evaluates latent sparsity and manifold-dimension estimation, including on language model activations. This gives substantial insight into representation structure, but it does not study how models use those representations to produce behavior; its connection to compositionality is incidental.

    本文提出一种混合自编码器，证明其能够恢复分布在多个流形并集上的结构化数据，并评估潜在稀疏性和流形维数估计，包括在语言模型激活上的表现。这为表征结构提供了重要见解，但没有研究模型如何利用这些表征产生行为；其与组合性的联系只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Is there really much more to say about sparse autoencoders (SAEs)? Autoencoders in general, and SAEs in particular, represent deep architectures that are capable of modeling low-dimensional latent structure in data. Such structure could reflect, among other things, correlation patterns in large language model activations, or complex natural image manifolds. And yet despite the wide-ranging applicability, there have been relatively few changes to SAEs beyond the original recipe from decades ago, namely, standard deep encoder/decoder layers trained with a classical/deterministic sparse regularizer applied within the latent space. One possible exception is the variational autoencoder (VAE), which adopts a stochastic encoder module capable of producing sparse representations when applied to manifold data. In this work we formalize underappreciated weaknesses with both canonical SAEs, as well as analogous VAEs applied to similar tasks, and propose a hybrid alternative model that circumvents these prior limitations. In terms of theoretical support, we prove that global minima of our proposed model recover certain forms of structured data spread across a union of manifolds. Meanwhile, empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets substantiate the efficacy of our approach in accurately estimating underlying manifold dimensions and producing sparser latent representations without compromising reconstruction error. In general, we are able to exceed the performance of equivalent-capacity SAEs and VAEs, as well as recent diffusion models where applicable, within domains such as images and language model activation patterns.

    关于稀疏自编码器（SAE），真的还有很多可说的吗？一般而言，自编码器，尤其是 SAE，是能够对数据中的低维潜在结构建模的深度架构。这类结构可能反映大型语言模型激活中的相关模式，也可能反映复杂的自然图像流形。然而，尽管适用范围广泛，除数十年前的原始方案外，SAE 几乎没有变化；该方案采用标准的深层编码器/解码器层，并在潜在空间中施加经典的确定性稀疏正则化。一个可能的例外是变分自编码器（VAE），它采用随机编码器模块，在应用于流形数据时能够产生稀疏表征。在这项工作中，我们形式化地阐述了经典 SAE 及应用于类似任务的对应 VAE 中一些未受充分重视的弱点，并提出一种能够规避这些既有局限的混合替代模型。理论方面，我们证明了所提模型的全局最优解能够恢复分布在多个流形并集上的某些结构化数据。同时，在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实证评估证实，该方法能够有效估计底层流形维数，并在不牺牲重建误差的情况下生成更稀疏的潜在表征。总体而言，在图像和语言模型激活模式等领域中，我们的方法超过了容量相当的 SAE 和 VAE，以及适用情况下的近期扩散模型。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper theoretically analyzes how pretrained transformers extract prompt-specific features at inference time and establishes sample-complexity gains. This offers substantial insight into adaptive feature learning, but the abstract does not address internal representations or compositional generalization directly.

    ENGLISH

    Pretrained transformers have demonstrated the ability to implement various algorithms at inference time without parameter updates. While theoretical works have established this capability through constructions and approximation guarantees, the optimization and statistical efficiency aspects remain understudied. In this work, we investigate how transformers learn features in-context -- a key mechanism underlying their inference-time adaptivity. We focus on the in-context learning of single-index models $y=\sigma_*(\langle \\boldsymbol{x},\\boldsymbol{\beta}\rangle)$, which are low-dimensional nonlinear functions parameterized by feature vector $\\boldsymbol\beta$. We prove that transformers pretrained by gradient-based optimization can perform *inference-time feature learning*, i.e., extract information of the target features $\\boldsymbol{\beta}$ solely from test prompts (despite $\\boldsymbol {\beta}$ varying across different prompts), hence achieving an in-context statistical efficiency that surpasses any non-adaptive (fixed-basis) algorithms such as kernel methods. Moreover, we show that the inference-time sample complexity surpasses the Correlational Statistical Query (CSQ) lower bound, owing to nonlinear label transformations naturally induced by the Softmax self-attention mechanism.

    Tao Feng, Yexin Wu, Guanyu Lin, Jiaxuan You

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The contribution is a graph world model that combines structured and multimodal states with task actions, and reports transfer to unseen tasks. Its reusable graph structures support compositional transfer (CompGen 4); planning and multi-agent tasks are evaluated, but reasoning is not the central contribution (3), while the model’s organization of states and actions substantially advances agent systems (4).

    本文的贡献是一种图世界模型，它将结构化和多模态状态与任务动作相结合，并报告了向未见任务的迁移。其可复用的图结构支持组合迁移（CompGen 4）；实验评估了规划和多智能体任务，但推理并非核心贡献（3）；同时，该模型对状态和动作的组织显著推进了智能体系统（4）。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models (WMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in prediction, generation, and planning tasks. Existing WMs primarily focus on unstructured data while cannot leverage the ubiquitous structured data, often represented as graphs, in the digital world. While multiple graph foundation models have been proposed, they focus on graph learning tasks and cannot extend to diverse multi-modal data and interdisciplinary tasks. To address these challenges, we propose the Graph World Model (GWM), a world model that supports both unstructured and graph-structured states with multi-modal information and represents diverse tasks as actions. The core of a GWM is a generic message-passing algorithm to aggregate structured information, either over a unified multi-modal token space by converting multi-modal data into text (GWM-T) or a unified multi-modal embedding space by modality-specific encoders (GWM-E). Notably, GWM introduces action nodes to support diverse tasks, where action nodes are linked to other nodes via direct reference or similarity computation. Extensive experiments on 6 tasks from diverse domains, including multi-modal generation and matching, recommendation, graph prediction, multi-agent, retrieval-augmented generation, and planning and optimization, show that the same GWM outperforms or matches domain-specific baselines' performance, benefits from multi-hop structures, and demonstrate strong zero-shot/few-shot capabilities on unseen new tasks. Our codes for GWM is released at https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/GWM.

    中文

    世界模型（WM）在预测、生成和规划任务中展现出强大的能力。 现有WM主要关注非结构化数据，无法利用数字世界中无处不在、通常以图形式表示的结构化数据。尽管已有多个图基础模型被提出，但它们聚焦于图学习任务，无法扩展到多样的多模态数据和跨学科任务。为应对这些挑战，我们提出图世界模型（GWM），这是一种同时支持包含多模态信息的非结构化状态和图结构化状态，并将多样任务表示为动作的世界模型。GWM的核心是一种通用消息传递算法，用于聚合结构化信息；它既可以通过将多模态数据转换为文本，在统一的多模态词元空间中运行（GWM-T），也可以通过模态专用编码器，在统一的多模态嵌入空间中运行（GWM-E）。值得注意的是，GWM引入了动作节点以支持多样任务，动作节点通过直接引用或相似度计算与其他节点相连。在来自不同领域的6项任务上进行的大量实验，包括多模态生成与匹配、推荐、图预测、多智能体、检索增强生成，以及规划与优化，表明同一个GWM的表现优于或达到领域专用基线的水平，能够从多跳结构中受益，并在未见过的新任务上展现出强大的零样本/少样本能力。GWM代码已发布于https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/GWM。

    Covered Forest: Fine-grained generalization analysis of graph neural networks

    覆盖森林：图神经网络的细粒度泛化分析

    Antonis Vasileiou, Ben Finkelshtein, Floris Geerts, Ron Levie, Christopher Morris

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a theoretical and empirical analysis of how graph structure, aggregation, and loss affect MPNN generalization. This directly advances structural generalization, though the abstract does not focus on recombining constituents or internal representation mechanisms.

    本文从理论和实证两方面分析图结构、聚合方式和损失函数如何影响MPNN的泛化。这直接推进了结构泛化研究，但摘要没有聚焦于重新组合各组成部分，也未关注内部表征机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The expressive power of message-passing graph neural networks (MPNNs) is reasonably well understood, primarily through combinatorial techniques from graph isomorphism testing. However, MPNNs' generalization abilities---making meaningful predictions beyond the training set---remain less explored. Current generalization analyses often overlook graph structure, limit the focus to specific aggregation functions, and assume the impractical, hard-to-optimize $0$-$1$ loss function. Here, we extend recent advances in graph similarity theory to assess the influence of graph structure, aggregation, and loss functions on MPNNs' generalization abilities. Our empirical study supports our theoretical insights, improving our understanding of MPNNs' generalization properties.

    中文

    消息传递图神经网络（MPNN）的表达能力已得到较为充分的理解，这主要得益于图同构测试中的组合技术。然而，MPNN的泛化能力——即对训练集之外的样本作出有意义预测的能力——仍较少受到研究。当前的泛化分析往往忽略图结构，将关注范围局限于特定聚合函数，并假设使用不切实际且难以优化的$0$-$1$损失函数。在此，我们拓展了图相似性理论的最新进展，以评估图结构、聚合方式和损失函数对MPNN泛化能力的影响。我们的实证研究支持了理论见解，并加深了对MPNN泛化性质的理解。

    How Transformers Learn Regular Language Recognition: A Theoretical Study on Training Dynamics and Implicit Bias

    Transformer 如何学习正则语言识别：关于训练动态与隐式偏置的理论研究

    Ruiquan Huang, Yingbin Liang, Jing Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper theoretically analyzes how a one-layer transformer learns regular-language tasks, including attention and classifier training dynamics and the role of CoT for parity. This gives substantial insight into model mechanisms and reasoning, with compositionality relevant to sequence-pattern integration but not the central focus; it does not study system design.

    本文从理论上分析单层 transformer 如何学习正则语言任务，包括注意力层和分类器的训练动态，以及 CoT 在奇偶校验任务中的作用。这为模型机制和推理提供了实质性洞见；组合性与序列模式整合有关，但不是本文重点；本文未研究系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language recognition tasks are fundamental in natural language processing (NLP) and have been widely used to benchmark the performance of large language models (LLMs). These tasks also play a crucial role in explaining the working mechanisms of transformers. In this work, we focus on two representative tasks in the category of regular language recognition, known as 'even pairs' and 'parity check', the aim of which is to determine whether the occurrences of certain subsequences in a given sequence are even. Our goal is to explore how a one-layer transformer, consisting of an attention layer followed by a linear layer, learns to solve these tasks by theoretically analyzing its training dynamics under gradient descent. While even pairs can be solved directly by a one-layer transformer, parity check need to be solved by integrating Chain-of-Thought (CoT), either into the inference stage of a transformer well-trained for the even pairs task, or into the training of a one-layer transformer. For both problems, our analysis shows that the joint training of attention and linear layers exhibits two distinct phases. In the first phase, the attention layer grows rapidly, mapping data sequences into separable vectors. In the second phase, the attention layer becomes stable, while the linear layer grows logarithmically and approaches in direction to a max-margin hyperplane that correctly separates the attention layer outputs into positive and negative samples, and the loss decreases at a rate of $O(1/t)$. Our experiments validate those theoretical results.

    中文

    语言识别任务是自然语言处理（NLP）的基础，常被用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）的性能。这些任务对于解释 transformer 的工作机制也至关重要。在这项工作中，我们聚焦于正则语言识别类别中的两项代表性任务，即“偶数对”和“奇偶校验”，其目标是判断给定序列中某些子序列的出现次数是否为偶数。我们的目标是通过理论分析梯度下降下的训练动态，探究由注意力层和线性层组成的单层 transformer 如何学习解决这些任务。 尽管单层 transformer 可以直接解决偶数对任务，但奇偶校验任务需要融入思维链（CoT）才能解决：可以将 CoT 融入针对偶数对任务训练良好的 transformer 的推理阶段，也可以将其融入单层 transformer 的训练过程。对于这两个问题，我们的分析表明，注意力层和线性层的联合训练分为两个明显阶段。第一阶段，注意力层快速增长，将数据序列映射为可分向量。第二阶段，注意力层趋于稳定，而线性层按对数速度增长，其方向趋近于一个最大间隔超平面，该超平面能将注意力层的输出正确划分为正样本和负样本，损失则以$O(1/t)$的速率下降。我们的实验验证了这些理论结果。

    Dynamical phases of short-term memory mechanisms in RNNs

    RNN 中短期记忆机制的动力学阶段

    Bariscan Kurtkaya, Fatih Dinc, Mert Yuksekgonul, Marta Blanco-Pozo, Ege Cirakman, Mark Schnitzer, Yucel Yemez, Hidenori Tanaka, Peng Yuan, Nina Miolane

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes two mechanisms for short-term memory in RNNs and derives learning-rate scaling laws, supported by large-scale experiments. This offers substantial insight into internal mechanisms, though its focus is neuroscience-inspired RNN dynamics rather than compositionality or general-purpose reasoning.

    本文分析了 RNN 中短期记忆的两种机制，推导出学习率缩放规律，并以大规模实验提供支持。这为内部机制提供了实质性洞见，但重点是受神经科学启发的 RNN 动力学，而非组合性或通用推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Short-term memory is essential for cognitive processing, yet our understanding of its neural mechanisms remains unclear. Neuroscience has long focused on how sequential activity patterns, where neurons fire one after another within large networks, can explain how information is maintained. While recurrent connections were shown to drive sequential dynamics, a mechanistic understanding of this process still remains unknown. In this work, we introduce two unique mechanisms that can support this form of short-term memory: slow-point manifolds generating direct sequences or limit cycles providing temporally localized approximations. Using analytical models, we identify fundamental properties that govern the selection of each mechanism. Precisely, on short-term memory tasks (delayed cue-discrimination tasks), we derive theoretical scaling laws for critical learning rates as a function of the delay period length, beyond which no learning is possible. We empirically verify these results by training and evaluating approximately 80,000 recurrent neural networks (RNNs), which are publicly available for further analysis. Overall, our work provides new insights into short-term memory mechanisms and proposes experimentally testable predictions for systems neuroscience.

    中文

    短期记忆对认知处理至关重要，但我们对其神经机制的理解仍不清楚。神经科学长期以来一直关注如何通过序列活动模式（即大型网络中的神经元依次放电）解释信息的维持。尽管已有研究证明循环连接会驱动序列动力学，但这一过程的机制仍未明了。在这项工作中，我们提出两种能够支持这种短期记忆的独特机制：产生直接序列的慢点流形，以及提供时间局部近似的极限环。通过分析模型，我们确定了决定选择哪种机制的基本属性。具体而言，对于短期记忆任务（延迟线索判别任务），我们推导出临界学习率随延迟时长变化的理论缩放规律；超过临界学习率后将无法进行学习。我们通过训练和评估约 80,000 个循环神经网络（RNN）对这些结果进行了实证验证，这些网络已公开发布，供进一步分析。总体而言，我们的工作为短期记忆机制提供了新见解，并提出了可通过实验检验的系统神经科学预测。

    Representations Shape Weak-to-Strong Generalization: Theoretical Insights and Empirical Predictions

    表征塑造弱到强泛化：理论洞见与实证预测

    Yihao Xue, Jiping Li, Baharan Mirzasoleiman

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper theoretically characterizes weak-to-strong generalization through kernels of models’ internal representations and proposes a label-free metric to predict performance. This offers substantial representation-based insight relevant to MechInterp, while its focus is generalization rather than reasoning capability, and the abstract does not establish compositional or systems contributions.

    本文通过模型内部表征的核从理论上刻画弱到强泛化，并提出一种无需标签即可预测性能的指标。这为表征提供了实质性洞见，与机制可解释性研究相关；其重点是泛化而非推理能力，摘要也未能证明其对组合性或系统领域有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Weak-to-Strong Generalization (W2SG), where a weak model supervises a stronger one, serves as an important analogy for understanding how humans might guide superhuman intelligence in the future. Promising empirical results revealed that a strong model can surpass its weak supervisor. While recent work has offered theoretical insights into this phenomenon, a clear understanding of the interactions between weak and strong models that drive W2SG remains elusive. We investigate W2SG through a theoretical lens and show that it can be characterized using kernels derived from the principal components of weak and strong models' internal representations. These kernels can be used to define a space that, at a high level, captures what the weak model is unable to learn but is learnable by the strong model. The projection of labels onto this space quantifies how much the strong model falls short of its full potential due to weak supervision. This characterization also provides insights into how certain errors in weak supervision can be corrected by the strong model, regardless of overfitting. Our theory has significant practical implications, providing a representation-based metric that predicts W2SG performance trends without requiring labels, as shown in experiments on molecular predictions with transformers and 5 NLP tasks involving 52 LLMs.

    中文

    弱到强泛化（W2SG）指由弱模型监督更强模型，是理解未来人类可能如何引导超人类智能的重要类比。令人鼓舞的实证结果表明，强模型能够超越其弱监督者。近期研究已为这一现象提供了一些理论洞见，但驱动 W2SG 的弱模型与强模型之间的相互作用仍未得到清晰理解。我们从理论角度研究 W2SG，并表明可以用从弱模型和强模型内部表征的主成分导出的核来刻画它。这些核可用于定义一个空间；从宏观层面看，该空间刻画了弱模型无法学习、但强模型能够学习的内容。标签在这一空间上的投影量化了由于弱监督，强模型距离充分发挥潜力还差多少。这一刻画也揭示了强模型如何纠正弱监督中的某些错误，无论是否发生过拟合。我们的理论具有重要的实际意义：它提供了一种基于表征的指标，无需标签即可预测 W2SG 的性能趋势；分子预测实验以及涉及 52 个 LLM 的 5 项 NLP 任务均展示了这一点。

    Aligning Multimodal Representations through an Information Bottleneck

    通过信息瓶颈对齐多模态表示

    Antonio Almudévar, José Miguel Hernández-Lobato, Sameer Khurana, Ricard Marxer, Alfonso Ortega

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes modality-specific information as a cause of poor multimodal representation alignment, gives an Information Bottleneck account, and proposes a regularizer to reduce it. This offers substantial insight into representation geometry, while multimodal pairing alone provides only an incidental connection to composition.

    本文分析了模态特定信息如何导致多模态表示对齐不佳，从信息瓶颈的角度进行阐释，并提出正则化项来减少这种信息。这为表示几何提供了重要见解；而仅仅将多种模态配对，与组合性的联系则只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Contrastive losses have been extensively used as a tool for multimodal representation learning. However, it has been empirically observed that their use is not effective to learn an aligned representation space. In this paper, we argue that this phenomenon is caused by the presence of modality-specific information in the representation space. Although some of the most widely used contrastive losses maximize the mutual information between representations of both modalities, they are not designed to remove the modality-specific information. We give a theoretical description of this problem through the lens of the Information Bottleneck Principle. We also empirically analyze how different hyperparameters affect the emergence of this phenomenon in a controlled experimental setup. Finally, we propose a regularization term in the loss function that is derived by means of a variational approximation and aims to increase the representational alignment. We analyze in a set of controlled experiments and real-world applications the advantages of including this regularization term.

    中文

    对比损失已被广泛用作多模态表示学习的工具。 然而，经验观察表明，使用对比损失并不能有效地学习对齐的表示空间。 本文认为，这一现象是由表示空间中存在模态特定信息造成的。 尽管一些应用最广泛的对比损失会最大化两种模态表示之间的互信息，但它们并非为去除模态特定信息而设计。 我们从信息瓶颈原理的角度对这一问题给出了理论描述。 我们还在受控实验设置中，通过经验分析不同超参数如何影响这一现象的出现。 最后，我们提出一个损失函数中的正则化项，该项通过变分近似推导得出，旨在提高表示对齐程度。 我们在一系列受控实验和真实世界应用中分析了加入这一正则化项的优势。
